latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "Still Image to Video" skill.
- Instantly turn uploaded still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 50MB) into animated 1080p MP4 video clips via simple instructions.
- Automatic cloud setup connects you to the video processing API on first use—no manual configuration required.
- Supports actions like upload, animate, export, check credits, and manage session state using smart prompt classification.
- Handles all rendering server-side on GPU nodes, delivering results in about 20-40 seconds per clip.
- Includes error handling for expired tokens, unsupported files, rate limits, and other common issues.
